fusions.name: Down the Loading Ramp
fusions.desc: Drives a charge through a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Unhurried Barge
fusions.desc: Rams the target for 28 damage, plus 6% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Stalls
fusions.desc: Lays a warm stall at your feet. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Steady as She Goes
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
